film: stoichiometric CoO, one or two atomic layers; epitaxial registry
constraints: for thickness/support comparisons, substrate atoms and two interfacial Co atoms may relax only along surface normal; document any alternative

reaction.reactant: CO adsorbed near a designated outermost surface O
reaction.product: CO2 desorbed/gas reference plus one vacancy at that O site

charge_definition: Bader charge transfer summed for the outermost CoO layer relative to the noble-metal slab; state sign convention and partition details
allowed_variants: Independent conformer, magnetic-state, cell-size, k-point, cutoff and functional/U sensitivity studies are allowed if clearly labeled; do not mix variants in the primary comparison.
